EXC: <class 'click.exceptions.NoArgsIsHelpError'> Usage: snapshot [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Capture, inspect and compare frozen task state snapshots

Options:
  --help  Show the help message

Commands:
  delete (del,rm)  Delete a snapshot
  diff             Compare two snapshots by task object ID
  list (ls)        List snapshots
  save (s)         Capture a snapshot of the current task state
  show             Show the tasks frozen in a snapshot
  where            Show the stack of a running task frozen in a snapshot
